title: Link the manifest and icons

Explain the example for link the manifest and icons

blocks.text: The page must link its manifest. Icons should be real image files in the sizes declared by the manifest.

These examples belong in separate files on your own HTTPS or localhost site. Service workers need that trusted origin and cannot run in this site's sandbox. Use browser developer tools to inspect them.

blocks.code:
<link rel="manifest" href="/manifest.webmanifest">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#174a8b">
<!-- In the manifest, add real 192x192 and 512x512 PNG icons with their actual sizes. -->
blocks.title: Link the manifest and icons

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `rel="manifest"` tells the browser what kind of linked file this is.
Icon size declarations must describe actual files the browser can download.

blocks.text: The browser can discover the manifest from the page. In its app tools, check that the manifest and icons load without errors.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not list icon files that do not exist. Use actual local images and accurate size values.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Check the manifest request in the browser Network panel.
